verdict.rationale: Trello documents task cards tracked on a visual board, including creating cards by email, setting a due date from the card title, and setting due dates on checklist items. A hands-on user praises the easy "add people" feature, though no first-party doc explicitly describes assigning a card to a teammate. missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of assigning cards/members to tasks, independent corroboration of due-date and assignment workflows.
